title: Haye Masjid Main Qatal Ghazi Ka Baba
body:
Haye masjid main qatal ghazi ka baba ho gaya
fatima ke betiyon par zulam kaisa ho gaya
`Har taraf mehshar bapa hay , Ro Rahe hay Zulfiqar
lag gaye, Haider kay Zarbat al amma ke the pukar
waqat hay sehree ka laykin, Kyon Andhera Ho gaya
Khuld say aye thi uss dam, yeh farishtoon ke sada
sar khula, hay Fatima ka roo rahay hain anbiya
Hashr say pehlay yeh kaisa, Hashr barpa ho gaya
cha gayen pardais main, saadaat par barbadyan
lut gayen, koofay main hain kooneen ke shahzadiyan
kat gaye sajday main Haider, deen zinda ho gaya
hain abhi shabbir O Shabbar , aur alambardar hai
ghar hai teray, baap ka ya sham ka bazar hai
sani-e-zahra tumhara, sar kyon uryaan ho gaya
mutmaien tha deen mohammad, jab jahan say chal diyee
baad ahmed, kay sahara deen ka haider banay
aaj haider chal basay hain, deen Tanha ho gaya
nasir-e-deen-e-nabi sajday main zakhmi kab howa
sha nay, pani ka pyala apnay qatil ko diya
ibanay muljim say kaha tha kaam tera ho gay
